messages.content: "Can you help me with some gaming information? First, I want to know about the rewards I can get from playing 'Call of Duty' on my 'Playstation'. Second, I am curious about the scores and rankings on level 3 of 'FIFA' on 'Xbox'. Third, I would like to know all the missions for 'Assassin Creed'. Lastly, I want to know the rewards for the 'Master' trophy level in 'Fortnite' on my 'PC'."

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

message.reasoning:
The user wants multiple pieces of information. We have four requests:

1. Rewards for Call of Duty on Playstation. They didn't specify mission or trophy, so we can call game_rewards_get with game="Call of Duty", platform="Playstation", mission="", trophy="".

2. Scores and rankings for FIFA level 3 on Xbox. They didn't specify player, so we can call game_scores_get with game="FIFA", platform="Xbox", level=3, player="".

3. Missions for Assassin Creed. We need to list all missions for that game. So call game_missions_list with game="Assassin Creed".

4. Rewards for Fortnite on PC for Master trophy. They didn't specify mission, so mission="" and trophy="Master". So call game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="PC", mission="", trophy="Master".

We should call each function separately. The user wants all four. There's no conflict. We'll do them in order.
